elevation.before: petalTongue — content rendering, WASM (camelCase, lowercase start)
elevation.after: PETALTONGUE — THE TONGUE (THE FIRST PRIMAL WITH A CAPITAL NAME)
elevation.why: It's not just a renderer. It's THE TONGUE of the organism. The organ that TASTES data at the boundary between mouth and gut.

taste_buds.bitter: petal-tongue-headless (headless — the background taste, no flavor needed)
taste_buds.umami: petal-tongue-wasm (WASM — the rich compiled browser taste)

tongue_anatomy.papillae: 19 crates in workspace = 19 types of taste receptor
tongue_anatomy.frenulum: petal-tongue-ipc = the connective tissue that holds the tongue to the floor of the mouth

tty_cis_trans.thesis: TTY IS the cis/trans of the TONGUE in the MOUTH

cis.name: LOCAL TTY
cis.what: You are AT the keyboard. The tongue tastes directly.
cis.mode: petal-tongue-tui → ratatui + crossterm → Pure Rust terminal tongue

trans.name: REMOTE TTY (pts)
trans.what: You taste THROUGH the nerve (SSH). The tongue is at the other end.
trans.mode: Same petal-tongue-tui but the TTY crosses the network

tty_cis_trans.crossing: CIS=local (same side as the tongue), TRANS=remote (other side of the nerve). SSH = the nerve that carries taste from gate to gate.
tty_cis_trans.note: When Kevin SSHs from northGate to eastGate, his TTY is TRANS — the tongue is tasting at a distance through the 10G fiber optic nerve.

vdj_rp.VDJ: Variable-Diversity-Joining — the immune recombination that creates unique receptors
vdj_rp.RP: Reverse Proxy — dromedary routes traffic to the tongue
vdj_rp.connection: VDJ recombination at the tongue = each TTY session gets a UNIQUE taste receptor (different pts device, different env, different bingoCube hash). RP = the palate that routes food to the right taste bud.
vdj_rp.dromedary_role: dromedary (reverse proxy) sits in FRONT of petalTongue — it's the LIPS that shape the food before the tongue tastes it

spore_words_gis.insight: GIS IS IN THE TONGUE! The tongue knows WHERE it is tasting from!
spore_words_gis.encoding: WGS84 lat/lng/alt → BIP-39 word phrases (human-memorable GPS)
spore_words_gis.note: The tongue doesn't just taste WHAT — it knows WHERE. Geographic awareness built into the tasting organ.

seven_modes.ui: GUI mode — egui/eframe — the visible tongue (display)
seven_modes.tui: TUI mode — ratatui/crossterm — the TTY tongue (terminal)
seven_modes.headless: Headless mode — blind tongue (daemon, no display)
seven_modes.server: Server mode — the tongue that serves others
seven_modes.status: Status mode — the tongue reports its own health

doom_core.why: If it can run Doom, the tongue can render ANYTHING
doom_core.note: Platform testing via the universal benchmark: can it run Doom?

in_the_digestion.position: Between the MOUTH (Porkbun DNS) and the GUT (ollama)
in_the_digestion.role: The tongue TASTES incoming data before it enters the stomach
taste_types: RSS feed items → taste for relevance
API calls → taste for rate limiting

connections.pore_dissolution: The tongue IS the pore's inner surface — it lines the torPore/ channel
connections.tube_eye: The tongue is inside the tube — the tube's inner lining IS taste receptors
connections.klein_palm: The tongue crosses CIS/TRANS like the Klein bottle — inside=outside
